mapper.select: /* apiSimpleView.selSpcEssential */ SELECT s.api_spc_no AS apiSpcNo ,s.api_nm AS apiNm ,s.ver AS ver ,s.sys_id AS sysId ,sys.sys_nm AS sysNm ,s.api_desc AS apiDesc ,s.host AS host ,s.bas_path AS basPath ,s.reg_sttus_cd AS regSttusCd ,s.api_class AS apiClass FROM KOA_TB_API_SPC s LEFT JOIN KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM sys ON sys.SYS_ID = s.SYS_ID WHERE s.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}::integer

/* apiSimpleView.selDefList */ SELECT d.api_no AS apiNo ,d.api_spc_no AS apiSpcNo ,d.api_nm AS apiNm ,d.api_ctgry_no AS apiCtgryNo ,c.ctgry_nm AS ctgryNm ,d.api_path AS apiPath ,d.method_cd AS methodCd ,d.api_desc AS apiDesc ,d.use_yn AS useYn ,d.show_status_cd AS showStatusCd FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF d LEFT JOIN KOA_TB_API_CTGRY c ON c.API_CTGRY_NO = d.API_CTGRY_NO WHERE d.API_SPC_NO = #{apiSpcNo}::integer ORDER BY d.SORT_ODRG, d.API_NO

/* apiSimpleView.selDefDetail */ SELECT api_no AS apiNo ,api_spc_no AS apiSpcNo ,api_nm AS apiNm ,api_ctgry_no AS apiCtgryNo ,api_path AS apiPath ,method_cd AS methodCd ,api_desc AS apiDesc ,use_yn AS useYn ,show_status_cd AS showStatusCd ,endpnt_method_cd AS endpntMethodCd ,endpnt_tb_url AS endpntTbUrl ,endpnt_prd_url AS endpntPrdUrl ,endpnt_client_ip AS endpntClientIp ,endpnt_timeout AS endpntTimeout ,resmap_res_cd_field AS resmapResCdField ,resmap_succ_val AS resmapSuccVal ,resmap_err_cd_field AS resmapErrCdField ,resmap_err_msg_field AS resmapErrMsgField ,hdp_api_out_format AS hdpApiOutFormat ,hdp_api_out_common_param AS hdpApiOutCommonParam ,hdp_api_endpoint_id AS hdpApiEndpointId ,hdp_req_api_name AS hdpReqApiName ,hdp_req_config_to_body AS hdpReqConfigToBody ,hdp_req_header_to_body AS hdpReqHeaderToBody ,hdp_req_mapping_to_body AS hdpReqMappingToBody ,hdp_req_url_decode AS hdpReqUrlDecode ,hdp_req_url_encode AS hdpReqUrlEncode ,hdp_res_mapping_to_body AS hdpResMappingToBody ,hdp_res_provide_param AS hdpResProvideParam ,hdp_res_url_encode AS hdpResUrlEncode ,hdp_ext_prop AS hdpExtProp ,hdp_hndlroptn_config AS hdpHndlroptnConfig ,bstgw_tb_sys_id AS bstgwTbSysId ,bstgw_prd_sys_id AS bstgwPrdSysId ,dply_req_flag AS dplyReqFlag ,tb_dply_status AS tbDplyStatus ,dply_veri_status AS dplyVeriStatus ,prd_dply_req_flag AS prdDplyReqFlag ,prd_dply_status AS prdDplyStatus FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF WHERE API_NO = #{apiNo}::integer

/* apiSimpleView.selParamList */ SELECT param_no AS paramNo ,param_nm AS paramNm ,data_type_cd AS dataTypeCd ,required AS required ,param_desc AS paramDesc ,param_loc AS paramLoc ,param_type_cd AS paramTypeCd ,sort_odrg AS sortOdrg ,prnts_param_no AS prntsParamNo ,obj_no AS objNo ,obj_odrg AS objOdrg ,exam AS exam ,personal_data AS personalData FROM KOA_TB_API_PARAM WHERE API_NO = #{apiNo}::integer ORDER BY SORT_ODRG, PARAM_NO
mapper.delete: /* apiSimpleView.delParamsByApiNo */ DELETE FROM KOA_TB_API_PARAM WHERE API_NO = #{apiNo}::integer AND PARAM_TYPE_CD IN ('PRMTYP1010', 'PRMTYP1020')
